title: CosyVoice 3, text rules on

tricks: Breath, laugh, cough and sigh use the tokenizer's own tags
Giggle shares the laughter tag because there is no softer one
Um is written out as a word
The RL-tuned language model weights (llm.rl.pt) replace the stock ones
The built-in text clean-up is on, as the engine ships; it turns $2.50 into two point five dollars

why: The same CosyVoice 3 setup with its own text clean-up on, to hear what that does to the numbers.
